info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Fixed Asset Register Validation-spec
info.description: The Fixed Asset Register Validation API facilitates the validation of fixed asset registers within an enterprise banking context. This endpoint is designed for financial institutions seeking to ensure compliance and accuracy in their asset management processes. By utilizing this API, users can submit specific parameters to validate asset records and receive confirmation of their integrity. Typical consumers include accountants, financial analysts, and regulatory compliance teams who require assurance regarding fixed assets before financial reporting.

post.summary: Validates the fixed asset register entry for a specific resource.
post.description: This operation checks the validation status of the fixed asset register entry identified by RES-100045. It ensures that all necessary requirements are met before further processing the asset details.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to validate fixed asset entries within the specified register. It requires data structured according to the fixed asset validation schema, ensuring that all required fields are populated correctly to facilitate accurate validation processing.
